title: discovery.py: Negative hop count from unchecked hop_limit
description: Line 131: `actual_hops = INITIAL_HOP_LIMIT - rreq.hop_limit` can produce negative values if a received RREQ has `hop_limit > INITIAL_HOP_LIMIT`. This negative value is stored as `hop_count` and `metric` in the RouteEntry (lines 136-137). A malicious node could forge RREQs with inflated hop_limit values, creating routes with negative metrics that would be preferentially selected over legitimate routes. Fix: validate `rreq.hop_limit <= INITIAL_HOP_LIMIT` before computing `actual_hops`, or clamp to zero.
